cases.name: Judy Solorio
cases.about: Judy was a medical assistant. “She was amazing & we’ve always had each other’s back. So to not to have her, it’s not real yet,” said Andrea Joseph about her little sister Judy. “She was strong willed, & smart, & witty & loud & out there,” says Andrea.
